artworks.title: The Triumph of Amphitrite
artworks.description: Poussin's classical tableau presents Amphitrite as the sea's queen, borne in triumph with Tritons and Nereids — the consort of Poseidon given the majesty Homer usually veils behind the epithet "deep-moaning Amphitrite." The painting fixes the goddess in her double role as Nereid-born bride and sovereign of the waves.

artworks.title: Poseidon and Amphitrite (mosaic from Zeugma)
artworks.description: A Roman floor mosaic from Zeugma shows Poseidon and Amphitrite enthroned together, the sea-god's consort at his side with her own trident and marine train. Such paired iconography made the queen of the sea a standard figure in the visual vocabulary of the Mediterranean empire.
